policies.termsAndConditions:
WELCOME TO SADA BAHAR EVENT & DECOR TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. BOOKINGS & DEPOSITS
All event decoration and setup bookings require confirmation with an advance deposit. Event dates are locked upon receipt of the deposit.

2. CANCELLATION POLICY
Cancellations made 14 days prior to the event date are eligible for partial refund minus administrative and flower pre-reservation costs. Cancellations within 7 days of the event are non-refundable.

3. DAMAGE TO DECOR ASSETS
Clients are responsible for any intentional damage or loss of rented furniture, stage lights, sofas, or props during the event duration.

4. SETUP TIME
Our team requires a minimum setup window of 4–6 hours prior to event commencement depending on the complexity of the stage and venue size.
policies.privacyPolicy:
SADA BAHAR EVENT & DECOR PRIVACY POLICY

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We collect customer contact details (Name, Phone number, Email) provided through our website query forms and review submissions strictly to fulfill service inquiries and maintain customer relations.

2. USE OF CUSTOMER PHOTOS
Customer review photos submitted via our website are published only upon moderation approval.

3. DATA PROTECTION
We do not sell, rent, or share customer contact information with third-party marketing companies.

4. CONTACT US
For questions regarding our privacy policy, contact us at 0333-9161630 or 0332-5841288.
